messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: metering-alert - token-count drift detected for eu-west-1 ingestion. delta=+6.8% (15m). Triggered overage flags for ~3 customers. Pager routed to @mia.

mia: i'm on it — switching context. initial ask: is this replication drift (shadow vs primary) or delayed emitter? leo, can you pull shadow vs primary sums?

leo: pulling now. quick check shows shadow agg lag ~18m; primary shows steady tokens; shadow backlog ~= 120k messages. running query...

leo: ```sql
SELECT window_start, sum(tokens) as tokens_shadow
FROM shadow_aggregator
WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY window_start
ORDER BY window_start DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

sam: kafka-consumer-eu spikes in CPU, consumer lags at offset ~42M -> 42.3M. I can restart the consumer (safe) or bump partitions. recommendation: restart consumer first.

mia: do it. leo, meanwhile can you validate overage flag list so we can avoid false billing alerts?

leo: grabbing affected accounts: acct_321, acct_654, acct_999. Overflag rule fired on 15m window. I'll disable overage alerting for those accounts in eu-west until backfill completes.

leo: ```bash
./runbook disable-overflag --region eu-west-1 --window 15m --accounts acct_321,acct_654,acct_999 --note "incident 1767778888 - temporary pause"
```

ana: @mia @leo thx — CS: prepping customer notes. Are these invoices at risk or just temporary UI overflags?

mia: invoices not affected (billing write path intact). These are alert flags from streaming counts; pause avoids churn. Backfill will reconcile counts to ledger. ETA for backfill: ~45m after consumer restart.

sam: restarted consumer at 1767778920. offsets moving, backlog decreasing (42.3M -> 42.05M), CPU stabilizing :white_check_mark:

leo: started backfill job (job-id bf-2026-03-18-176777). monitoring token commits to ledger. current delta trending down 6.8% -> 1.4% over 20m

mia: summary for postmortem: root cause = kafka consumer GC spike + inefficient shard rebalance causing shadow aggregator lag -> overflags. Mitigations applied: restarted consumer, paused overflags for affected accounts, triggered backfill. Next steps: longer-term perf tuning + alert on consumer latency > 10s.

jen: tagging product/pm @raj for follow-up on customer comms and runbook updates.

raj: noted. we should add a safety throttle on overflagging to avoid customer noise (e.g., require 2 windows before firing). I'll draft RFC.

mia: current status: partial customer impact (UI alerts only). backups: backfill in progress, overflags paused. will update in 30m. :eyes:
